Following other style transfer work with a parallel corpus, we evaluate our models for semantic similarity with the ground truth using the BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore. Since there are two ground truth annotations per tweet, we take the maximum of the two scores and report the average across these maxima. We also report ∆TextBlob or the average change in sentiment score according to TextBlob.
